items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Joe Shulman, my shadow, was Thornhill- Claude Thornhill's base player. He loved me.

ctx.x: Yeah, Metronome, I'm sorry. And the ratings you know. Now any record that I was on, he'd say was a bad record or my name wasn't mentioned on the record. Once it popped up and down in the corner there was a notation. This issue Leonard Feather is on vacation in Miami, Florida. But I blew the Esquire Award by whipping him. Oscar Pettiford had only been in town a week and they gave it to him, you know. Not that he didn't deserve it. I say he's a hell of a bass player. But there were other bass players around by town…

base player. He loved me. It was, there was a nice sprinkling rankle of base players around town that could have played it just as well, I mean, but Oscar being a soloist, you know. They took him. I'll go along with it. Because I loved Oscar, you know, second to Blanton, solo wise.
